products.body:
The Naturehike Aqua Shoe is a lightweight water shoe built for beach, river, and water-based activities. A highly elastic mesh upper breathes well and dries quickly, while drainage holes in the rubber sole prevent water pooling underfoot. Two adjustable straps allow a secure, customised fit across different foot shapes.

Best for
Beach walks, fishing, rowing, kloofing, and water-based activities — or as a lightweight second shoe on multi-day hikes where a packable water crossing option is needed.

Not ideal for
Primary hiking footwear on rough or technical terrain where ankle support and a stiffer sole are required.

Additional features
- Drainage holes in the sole allow water to escape quickly after submersion.
- Anti-slip rubber tread provides grip on wet rocks and surfaces.
- Highly elastic mesh upper stretches to accommodate different foot shapes
- Lightweight at ±299 g
products.title: Aqua Shoes

products.body:
Gaiters that seal the gap between boot and trouser, where grass seeds, thorns and mud get in. The three-layer laminate is rated to 10,000 mm hydrostatic head while still passing 5,000 g of moisture vapour per square metre a day, so wet grass stays out without your legs cooking.

Best for
Trails through overgrown grass, thornveld and wet undergrowth, and stream crossings where water runs down into the boot.

Not ideal for
Hot, dry and open trails. Any gaiter adds warmth around the lower leg, so on an exposed summer walk you may prefer to go without.

Additional features
- Protects the ankle and shin from thorns and branches
- Keeps grass seeds out of socks and boot tops
- Packs to 105 × 155 mm
- Wipes clean and dries quickly
products.title: Waterproof Trekking Gaiters
